_meta.purpose: THE HAND-AUTHORED CURATION INPUT. Everything in gate.json that is a JUDGEMENT rather than an arithmetic result lives here: the epistemic tier of every source, the disposition of every unresolved edge endpoint, the audit's ejections, the blockers' exclusions, the node splits and the named reconciliations.
_meta.readBy: scripts/seed-opgraph-gate.mjs (tracked, dependency-free, idempotent). That script computes gate.json = decisions + slices; scripts/gen-opgraph.mjs then computes assets/js/core/data/opgraph.js = gate + slices + vocab.
_meta.why: A weight must be COMPUTED, never argued into existence (PLAN §3.2). The only way to keep that true while still exercising judgement is to separate the two files: this one holds the judgements, gate.json holds the arithmetic, and the arithmetic is recomputed and re-checked on every run.

sourceTiers._note: tier ∈ primary | secondary-scholarly | tertiary. PRIMARY = an edition, translation, manuscript catalogue or the primary text itself. SECONDARY-SCHOLARLY = a monograph, journal article, dissertation or academic project page. TERTIARY = an encyclopaedia, digest, popular web page, or REPO PRIOR ART (affiliated: the site citing itself is not an independent witness). The seeder FAILS on an unmapped source key.

affiliatedSources._note: Sources that are the repo citing itself. Under the rubric these are TERTIARY (so primaryFactor caps at 0.6), because a site is not an independent witness to its own claims.

endpointDispositions._note: W1 RESOLUTION RULE. Every unresolved edge endpoint becomes EXACTLY ONE OF: (a) MINT — a minted node of a declared type; (b) ATLAS-REF — a cross-link to a confluence slug, NOT a node in this graph, edge dropped, fact moved to the source node's notes; (c) NOTE — a plain note, edge dropped. NO ENDPOINT IS RESOLVED BY INVENTING A NODE. 'procedure-type' endpoints are consumed by the claim machinery (see vocab-map.json endpointMap) and their raw CONTAINS_PROCEDURE edges are never emitted.

mintedAuthorKinds._note: kind ∈ person | pseudonymous-attribution | anonymous-hand | corporate. This exists because slice 14 found THREE SEPARATE AUTHORSHIP SITUATIONS WITH ONE SHAPE — Hekhalot macroforms, the Lurianic corpus, the corpus Bunianum — all of which defeat a naive work→AUTHORED_BY→author edge. R34 ADDED TWO ENTRIES, both surfaced by the new check L in og-artery.mjs ('a kind:person node must not be labelled by a denial of its own authorship'). (1) person:pseudo-agrippa — minted so the spurious Fourth Book stops pointing at the real Agrippa's node; it follows the convention this corpus already used for pseudo-Peter of Abano, pseudo-Majrīṭī and pseudo-Apollonius. (2) ea:author-kukai retyped person → pseudonymous-attribution: its ONLY work, the Shingon shidō kegyō corpus, carries the author string 'transmitted from Kūkai; the shidai are lineage compilations, largely anonymous or lineage-attributed', which is the same situation as ea:author-shao-yong-attributed and ea:author-wei-boyang-attributed — a corpus ascribed to a real named figure who did not compose it. NOT a claim that Kūkai (774–835) is unhistorical; the node id keeps his name because the ASCRIPTION is what the node represents.

gw:weyer-pseudomonarchia.why: Weyer's catalogue is a DENUNCIATORY LIST inside De praestigiis daemonum; it records a corpus it rejects.

gw:scot-discoverie.why: Scot prints the material inside a sceptical polemic. Peterson's stemma turns on Scot 1665's inherited unique errors — a material fingerprint, which is a property of a record.

gw:dee-angelic-diaries.why: See nodeSplits: the diaries are a session record; the compiled manuals are a formulary. That difference is the whole point of the split.

tan:atharvaveda-saunaka.why: The slice's own structuralNote: 'A hymn collection, NOT a manual. The hymns state intent and address the agent; they do not lay out a sequence.'

yijing.why: The canonical Classic of Change; slice 13 records that the Xici is insufficient as a procedure and that Zhu Xi had to reconstruct one.

ea:yixue-qimeng.why: Zhu Xi's introduction to the study of the Classic of Change: it exists to supply what the Xici withholds.

sefer-yetzirah.why: Slice 14's ruling, endorsed by the audit as 'a rare case of an audit confirming a null': SY is the ancestor of the Jewish half and is ITSELF NOT OPERATIVE. Every procedure attached to it arrives in the commentary tradition. Attaching golem-making to it would be a regression.

isl:naqshbandi-kalimat-qudsiyya.why: DECISION D2's ONE QUALIFIED EXCEPTION. The kalimāt-i qudsiyya is a rule-set carried across many texts with no single edition. Forcing it into a fictional book-node would falsify the record; hanging it on a person-node would break the rule that procedures hang off works and work-segments only. Resolution: kind on the work node.

jew:shaar-hakavvanot.why: The other half of D2's exception: the Lurianic material is disciple-redaction of a man who wrote almost nothing. Vital records; Luria taught.

gw:lemegeton.why: HAS_PART is load-bearing, not cosmetic: 'Ars Notoria (13th c., devotional, notae-dependent) and Ars Goetia (17th c., coercive, complete) cannot share a completeness grade.' The Lemegeton's five books differ by four centuries in origin, so the container carries no single role.

propagatedTypes._note: THE MALLINSON STANDARD, made explicit. procedureLevel:true is only true if the edge NAMES the propagated procedure. Where a slice set the flag without naming a controlled term, the term is named here or the edge is demoted to work-level — the whole point of this graph is to add procedure-level claims WITHOUT silently upgrading the work-level ones.

isl:lataif-al-isharat|isl:shams-al-maari.why: Gardiner's manuscript-culture argument: the authentic al-Būnī works are the historical core around which the printed compendium accreted, and what is carried forward is the lettrist talismanic material. Both endpoints carry consecration-of-object-talisman claims, so the propagated kind is nameable without inventing one.

sefer-yetzirah|jew:eleazar-worms-sy-comm.why: The commentary does not merely cite Sefer Yetzirah: it takes SY's alphabet-combination 'gates' as the operative engine of the golem rite and names them as such. THE MORE PRECISE TERM WOULD BE letter-permutation-contemplation, and it is not used, because a propagatedTypeTerm must resolve to a procedure-type NODE and that term is declared empty this round — the works that would occupy it are held under blocker B3. Naming an unoccupied term here would let a propagation claim conjure a type node that no graded claim supports. The occupied term the commentary's own claim carries is used instead, and the letter-gate mechanism is stated in the relation's note where it belongs.
sefer-yetzirah|jew:eleazar-worms-sy-comm.revisitIf: Bohak 2008 lands, letter-permutation-contemplation gains a graded claim, and the propagation can be re-typed at full precision.

razorRedactions._note: STRIKE R1'S RULE APPLIED FILE-GLOBALLY BY THE ARTERY, and the reason it is applied here rather than in the slices is that the slices are the AUDITED ARTEFACT and must stay as the audit left them. Each redaction is tombstoned in gate.ejected with reasonCode razor-violation, so the removal is countable and the argument that survived it is stated. A COMPLIANCE SENTENCE IS NOT COMPLIANCE: the artery does not ask a record whether it withholds, it checks.

entries.replace: AUDIT-CORRECTED (R1, applied by the artery): the two recensions state DIFFERENT lengths for the ordeal, and the durations are not reproduced here. The philological point is the disagreement, not the numbers — a procedure whose defining parameter is not determinate across its own witnesses is not a determinate procedure. The lengths are in Dehn & Guth and in Mathers (S8) for anyone doing the philology.
entries.why: A duration on a harm-flagged ascetic regimen is exactly what the razor forbids, and the finding — that the recensions disagree on the operation's defining parameter — survives the removal intact.
